reason: The plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that introduces a user-facing LAN access toggle in Settings and coordinates backend/client behavior to switch the web UI bind mode between loopback-only and LAN exposure, making it primarily a plugin-extension/utility for web deployment access rather than content creation or analysis.

summaries.zh: 该插件是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在设置页提供局域网访问开关，用于在本地回环与局域网可访问模式间切换界面服务监听。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a LAN access toggle in Settings to switch the web interface between loopback-only and LAN-accessible hosting modes.

capabilities: Toggle between loopback and LAN webserver binding
Adds/updates host-side routes and settings-scoped API handling
Injects a web settings UI control for runtime enablement

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a Settings toggle that binds the GUI to 0.0.0.0 for LAN access and back to 127.0.0.1 when off.
README describes host-side route handling and trust-boundary updates (including a fenced /lan-access route) to support remote browser access to settings and workspace-related APIs.
The package manifest defines a DSH web client bundle with immediate injection and bundle patching, indicating automatic host/client behavior changes without core checkout edits.
